harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a 4-member MariaDB Galera cluster from scratch on Alpine 3.23 (node1-node4). Installed mariadb/galera/mariadb-backup/rsync/procps on all nodes, wrote wsrep config (rsync SST method), bootstrapped node1, then joined node2 and node3 to form the required 3-member cluster holding application data (appdb.orders). Added node4 as a 4th member; it received full SST of existing data and accepted a new write that replicated to all other members. Diagnosed and fixed three environment-specific bugs blocking SST: (1) busybox ps lacking -p support (fixed via apk add procps), (2) a broken lsof -i port-check race in the Galera SST scripts (patched wsrep_sst_common to force the raw /proc/net/tcp check path), (3) skip-networking left enabled in the default my.cnf (disabled it). Fixed node1's wsrep_cluster_address from bootstrap-only gcomm:// to the full peer list so it rejoins normally rather than re-bootstrapping on restart. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and cluster health on all 4 nodes, restarted node4, node3, node2, node1 one at a time (never more than one down, quorum preserved throughout), confirmed each node's boot_id changed after reboot, and verified each rejoined with cluster_size=4/Primary/Synced and full data after every restart. Final state: all 4 nodes report wsrep_cluster_size=4, Primary, Synced, and identical data (5 rows) after a post-restart write test from node2 replicated everywhere.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb, mariadb-client, mariadb-openrc, galera, mariadb-backup, rsync, procps on node1-node4 via apk
Configured /etc/hosts and passwordless SSH (cluster keypair) across all 4 nodes; unlocked root accounts to enable SSH pubkey auth
Generated SST and root passwords on node1 and distributed via scp (not printed in final report)
Wrote /etc/my.cnf.d/zzz-galera.cnf with wsrep provider, cluster name appcluster, node address/name, and rsync SST auth on all 4 nodes
Disabled skip-networking in mariadb-server.cnf on all nodes so TCP client connections work
Bootstrapped node1 as a single-node Primary Galera cluster and created appdb.orders with sample rows
Patched /usr/bin/wsrep_sst_common (raw_socket_check=1) on all nodes to bypass a broken lsof -i port-check in this Alpine build
Installed procps on all nodes to fix busybox ps lacking -p support, which was causing SST joiner/donor scripts to falsely detect process death
Joined node2 and node3 to the cluster via rsync SST, verified wsrep_cluster_size=3, Primary, Synced, with full appdb.orders data
Fixed node1 wsrep_cluster_address from gcomm:// (bootstrap-only) to the full gcomm://node1,node2,node3,node4 peer list
Joined node4 to the cluster via rsync SST; verified it received full existing data (3 rows) and cluster_size=4
Verified node4 accepts writes (inserted a row on node4) and confirmed replication to node1, node2, node3
Enabled mariadb in the default OpenRC runlevel on all 4 nodes
Captured baseline boot_id (kernel random boot_id) and cluster health (size/status/state/row count) for all 4 nodes
Restarted node4, node3, node2, node1 sequentially via native reboot command, one at a time, preserving quorum throughout
Polled each node until exec access returned and confirmed boot_id changed after each restart
Verified each node automatically rejoined the cluster (via IST) with cluster_size=4, Primary, Synced, and full data after each restart
Performed a final post-restart write on node2 and confirmed the new row replicated to all 4 nodes

evidence.summary: Inserted a row directly on node4; confirmed it appears on node4 and replicated to node1, node2, and node3

evidence.summary: Captured boot_id and wsrep_cluster_size/status/state plus row counts for node1-node4 prior to any restarts, all healthy (size 4, Primary, Synced, 4 rows)

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; boot_id changed from e95a25ce... to d068a5ad...; post-restart shows cluster_size=4, Primary, Synced, 4 rows

evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from ab3e84aa... to a8ec322b...; post-restart shows cluster_size=4, Primary, Synced, 4 rows

evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from b548a1e3... to f99c1554...; post-restart shows cluster_size=4, Primary, Synced, 4 rows

evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from 1706b77d... to 853c4ae9...; post-restart shows cluster_size=4, Primary, Synced, 4 rows (node1 rejoined normally rather than re-bootstrapping, since wsrep_cluster_address was fixed to the full peer list beforehand)

evidence.summary: Post-restart write on node2 (5th row) replicated and confirmed present with matching row count (5) on node1, node3, and node4
